AfroBot Africa

01

Why we started

Kids in Bamenda were in school about four days a week because of the conflict there. Kids in other parts of the country were in school five days a week.

We wanted Bamenda kids on equal footing. AI and robotics classes were a way to give them that edge. The classes began in November 2022, under Glappy Foundation.

02

The holiday program

The holiday program is how the work grew. Every holiday we open the doors, bring more kids into the school, and train them in AI and robotics.

Nearly 5,000 children have trained this way. The number grows with each holiday.

03

Classrooms and learners building

In class, students work at laptops. They also share a computer, write code, and build a robot on the table.

04

Today's community

About 1,500 children are training with us now. More join every holiday.
